name: better-tasks
description: Plan and track tasks inside Claude Code, kept as plain Markdown files in your project, with weekly sprints, a sprint board and agent teammates.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Opens task files from the sprint board. auto: IntelliJ inside a JetBrains terminal, VS Code inside VS Code, else the default app.

worktree.title: Worktree per teammate
worktree.description: Each named teammate works in its own git worktree.

longCache.title: 1-hour prompt cache
longCache.description: Teammates and the manager keep their prompt cache for an hour, so a teammate stays cheap to resume. Unless you set a TTL yourself.

statusEvery.title: Status check (minutes)
statusEvery.description: After this many quiet minutes the manager checks the open work and moves it forward. 0 turns it off.

keepAwake.title: Keep the Mac awake
keepAwake.description: Holds caffeinate while any teammate runs.

demoVideos.title: Before/after videos
demoVideos.description: Teammates record the bug and the fix as one short video: BEFORE/AFTER labels, red boxes and arrows, subtitles read aloud by Kokoro (set up once per machine).

pullRequests.title: PR per task
pullRequests.description: Each teammate works in its own worktree and finishes with a GitHub pull request (with its before/after video); the manager merges it when you approve. Updates gh (Homebrew) when it is too old for the video.

teammateModel.title: Teammate model
teammateModel.description: The model teammates run on for easy and normal tasks. inherit: the manager's own model.

teammateEffort.title: Teammate effort
teammateEffort.description: How hard teammates think on those tasks.

hardModel.title: Hard-task model
hardModel.description: The model for hard tasks (deep debugging, security, changes across several areas) and for a teammate that replaces one that got stuck. inherit: the manager's own model.

hardEffort.title: Hard-task effort
hardEffort.description: How hard teammates think on hard tasks.

escalate.title: Escalate when stuck
escalate.description: A teammate that fails or goes in circles is replaced by one on the hard-task model and effort.

sprintWeeks.title: Sprint length (weeks)
sprintWeeks.description: How many weeks one sprint lasts (1 to 4).
